name: Source-and-access tagging
summary_ar: القدرة على تقييم كل معلومة على محورين منفصلين: موثوقية المصدر، وطريقة معرفته بالمعلومة (مباشرة، أو منقولة مؤيدة باستقلال، أو منقولة فقط، أو مجهولة). يستند إلى نظام التصنيف البريطاني 3x5x2، ويمنع خلط سمعة القائل بصحة ما يقول.
operational_definition: Given a clue, the learner assigns (a) a source rating (reliable/untested/doubtful) and (b) an access rating (direct/indirect-corroborated/indirect/unknown/suspected false) and justifies each separately.
practice_task_pattern: Clue cards arrive from mixed sources (eyewitness, rumour chain, anonymous note, CCTV log); learner applies two badges before the card can be pinned to the hypothesis board.
assessment_method: Agreement with designer key per badge; error typology (axis confusion: rating info higher because the source is liked).
observable_evidence: % of cards correctly badged on each axis
justification text mentions how the source knows
common_errors: letting source likeability set information credibility
evidence_strength: Professional standard (College of Policing APP); no published inter-rater reliability for 3x5x2 found; learning effect for teens untested.
transfer_notes: Direct analogue to evaluating social-media claims (who posted, how do they know).

name: Generating competing hypotheses
summary_ar: صياغة تفسيرين أو أكثر للمعطيات نفسها، منها تفسير لا يُدين المشتبه به الأبرز. مستمد من مطلب الممارسة المهنية البريطانية بتوليد فرضيات بديلة، ومن التحذير من الاكتفاء بأول تفسير مقبول. والدليل الميداني يُظهر أن المحققين المدرَّبين يولّدون فرضيات أكثر مطابقة لمعيار الخبراء.
operational_definition: Before the first accusation, learner records >=2 (13-15) or >=3 (16+) distinct hypotheses that each account for the core facts, at least one of which is non-incriminating for the leading suspect.
practice_task_pattern: Hypothesis board with empty slots; prompt 'What else could explain this?' after each major clue; expert gold-standard list per case.
assessment_method: Count and distinctness of hypotheses vs expert gold standard (Fahsing & Ask method); presence of an innocent explanation.
common_errors: three re-wordings of the same idea
satisficing on the first plausible story
evidence_strength: Moderate: field quasi-experiment with professionals (Fahsing & Ask 2016); professional guidance; no teen RCT.
transfer_notes: Transfers to explaining news events, school conflicts and science anomalies; must be measured outside the game.

name: Diagnostic and disconfirming testing
summary_ar: اختيار خطوة التحقيق التالية بحسب قدرتها على التمييز بين الفرضيات ومحاولة إسقاط الفرضية المفضلة، لا تأكيدها. يقوم على منطق تحليل الفرضيات المتنافسة وعلى طلب خطوط استقصاء تتجه بعيداً عن المشتبه به. والتجارب تُظهر أن الناس يميلون إلى اختيار تحقيقات تؤكد اعتقادهم الأولي، وإن كان الأثر معتدلاً.
operational_definition: When offered enquiry options, learner selects at least one option capable of disconfirming the favoured hypothesis and can state what result would lower its probability.
practice_task_pattern: 'Choose your next 3 enquiries' from a menu of incriminating, exonerating and neutral options (Rassin-style); post-choice prompt 'What would prove you wrong?'.
assessment_method: Incriminating-choice index across cases; quality of 'what would prove me wrong' statement (rubric 0-2).
common_errors: treating evidence consistent with all hypotheses as decisive
evidence_strength: Bias documented in analogue studies (Rassin et al. 2010); heavy structured tools (ACH) show mixed debiasing effects (Dhami et al. 2019) while a light active evidence-rating task reduced tunnel vision (Rassin 2018) - teen benefit unproven.
transfer_notes: Core of scientific reasoning; coordinate with Library 06/07 for hypothesis-testing measures.

name: Independence checking (avoiding double counting)
summary_ar: التمييز بين التأييد المستقل والتأييد الدائري أو الملوث. روايتان عن أصل واحد مصدر واحد، والحكم الخبير قد يتأثر بمعرفة سياق مثل الاعتراف. يستند إلى شرط التأييد المستقل في التصنيف البريطاني، وإلى أبحاث الانحياز السياقي في الأدلة الجنائية.
operational_definition: Learner traces two or more supporting items to their origin and correctly classifies them as independent or as sharing a source/contaminating context.
practice_task_pattern: Provenance tree puzzles with deliberate circular corroboration; lab-character contamination flag when confession info is shared before testing.
assessment_method: Correct independence classification; whether final report cites truly independent items.
common_errors: counting repeated rumours as multiple witnesses
sharing suspect info with forensic examiner
evidence_strength: Strong in principle (professional standard + contextual bias research); learning effects untested.
transfer_notes: High transfer to media literacy (tracing viral claims to origin).

name: Chronology building and inconsistency analysis
summary_ar: ترتيب الأحداث زمنياً لكشف الفجوات والتعارضات، ثم معاملة التعارض على أنه سؤال يحتاج توضيحاً لا دليل كذب تلقائياً. فالذاكرة الصادقة تخطئ في التوقيتات، والتعارض بين الإفادة والأدلة إشارة أفضل من سلوك المتكلم.
operational_definition: Learner places events on a timeline, flags conflicts, and for each conflict proposes at least one innocent and one non-innocent explanation before seeking clarification.
practice_task_pattern: Drag-and-drop timeline; conflicts highlighted in 'needs clarification' colour; follow-up question unlocked in interview.
assessment_method: Timeline accuracy; proportion of conflicts handled with clarification rather than accusation.
common_errors: treating any inconsistency as proof of lying
evidence_strength: Practice-based (PEACE 'account, clarify, challenge'); research shows honest recall contains some errors (CI meta-analysis).
transfer_notes: Transfers to history/source analysis tasks.

name: Open, non-leading questioning
summary_ar: طرح أسئلة مفتوحة تبدأ بالسرد الحر وتتجنب تضمين الإجابة. فصيغة السؤال والمعلومات اللاحقة قد تغيّر ذاكرة الشاهد، والمقابلة المعرفية تزيد التفاصيل الصحيحة زيادة كبيرة مع زيادة صغيرة في الأخطاء.
operational_definition: In interview scenes, learner opens with free recall and uses a majority of open questions; avoids questions that introduce unconfirmed details.
practice_task_pattern: Question bank tagged open/closed/leading; narrative consequence when leading questions contaminate later testimony.
assessment_method: Open:leading ratio; contamination events caused; post-interview self-evaluation (PEACE 'Evaluate').
evidence_strength: Strong lab evidence for CI and misinformation effects; mainly adult lab samples.
transfer_notes: Useful for everyday listening/asking skills; avoid implying learners can interview real witnesses.

name: Rejecting behavioural lie cues
summary_ar: مهارة معرفية-ما وراء معرفية: عدم عدّ التوتر أو تجنب النظر أو لغة الجسد دليلاً على الكذب، والاستعاضة عنها بمقارنة المحتوى بالأدلة. دقة البشر في كشف الكذب من السلوك نحو 54%، والخبراء ليسوا أفضل، والإشارات غير اللفظية ضعيفة وغير موثوقة.
operational_definition: Learner declines to use demeanour as evidence and, when tempted, re-routes to a statement-vs-evidence check.
practice_task_pattern: Cases include nervous innocents and calm guilty characters; myth-vs-science cards; behaviour notes auto-sorted to 'observation, not evidence'.
assessment_method: Frequency of demeanour items pinned as supporting evidence; pre/post myth-belief items.
evidence_strength: Very strong (large meta-analyses).
transfer_notes: Counters popular media myths; measure belief change over time.

name: Confidence-accuracy calibration about witnesses
summary_ar: الحكم على قيمة شهادة العيان بحسب الثقة الأولى وظروف جمعها، لا بحسب ثقة الشاهد اللاحقة. الثقة الأولى في ظروف نقية مؤشر قوي على الدقة، والثقة بعد تغذية راجعة أو إجراءات غير عادلة قد تضلل.
operational_definition: Learner weights a witness identification by initial confidence and procedure quality (instruction given, administrator blind, fair lineup, no feedback).
practice_task_pattern: Witness file shows first confidence statement and procedure log; later scenes show confidence inflation after feedback.
assessment_method: Correct weighting decisions in cases with pristine vs contaminated identifications.
evidence_strength: Strong for adults under pristine conditions; debated details; less known for teen witnesses.
transfer_notes: Teaches conditional reasoning: reliability depends on how evidence was collected.

name: Treating confessions and allegations as claims
name_ar: معاملة الاعتراف والادعاء كادعاءات تحتاج تأييداً
summary_ar: عدم إنهاء التحقيق باعتراف أو اتهام، وطلب تأييد مستقل، كتفصيلة لم تُكشف للمعترف. الاعترافات الكاذبة موثقة ولها عوامل خطر معروفة، منها صغر السن والأساليب الاتهامية، ونحو ربع المبرّئين بالحمض النووي في سجلات Innocence Project كانوا قد اعترفوا.
operational_definition: When a character confesses or accuses, learner seeks at least one independent corroborating detail before accepting it and labels the item as a claim.
practice_task_pattern: Cases with a protective false confession; mandatory 'what corroborates this from outside?' prompt.
assessment_method: Whether case is closed on confession alone; quality of corroboration sought.
evidence_strength: Strong (AP-LS scientific review papers 2010/2025; exoneration data with sampling caveats).
transfer_notes: Transfers to evaluating admissions/accusations in everyday disputes and online call-outs.

name: Expressing calibrated uncertainty
summary_ar: اختيار درجة احتمال من سُلّم لفظي-رقمي ثابت، وفصلها عن الثقة في متانة الأدلة. مستمد من ICD 203 ودراسة Kent التي بيّنت أن عبارات الاحتمال الغامضة تُفهم بتباين كبير. المقابلات العربية للسُّلّم لم تُختبر بعد.
operational_definition: Final conclusions include a probability band from the ATHAR ladder plus a separate evidence-strength rating; across cases, stated probabilities match hit rates.
practice_task_pattern: Two sliders in final report; Kent-style 'what does this phrase mean to you?' exercise; personal calibration dashboard.
assessment_method: Calibration curve / Brier-type score across >=N cases; mixing-likelihood-with-confidence errors.
evidence_strength: Standard-based (ICD 203); calibration trainable in adults (Mellers et al. 2014); verbal terms misread even with ranges, numbers preferred (Dhami & Mandel 2022); untested in Arabic or with teens.
transfer_notes: High transfer to science, health and news reasoning.

name: Rapport-based, non-coercive interviewing (fictional)
name_ar: المقابلة القائمة على الألفة وغير القسرية (في الخيال)
summary_ar: إدارة مشهد مقابلة خيالي وفق مراحل PEACE باحترام وأسئلة مفتوحة، دون تهديد أو خداع أو وعود. الأدلة تُظهر أن أسلوب جمع المعلومات يخفض الاعترافات الكاذبة، وأن الألفة ترتبط بمعلومات أكثر. والمعيار الدولي (مبادئ منديز) يرفض القسر.
operational_definition: Learner moves through plan, engage, account/clarify, close and evaluate; challenges inconsistencies calmly; never selects coercive or deceptive options.
practice_task_pattern: Interview scenes with PEACE stage markers; character openness responds to respect and open questions; coercive choices yield unreliable output and a debrief.
assessment_method: Rubric on stages completed, rapport moves, calm challenge, absence of coercive choices; post-interview self-evaluation.
evidence_strength: Moderate-strong: lab meta-analysis with few samples + field correlational study + international standard.
transfer_notes: Must be framed as communication skill, never as professional interrogation training.

name: Decision logging and revision
summary_ar: كتابة سبب كل قرار رئيسي، كإسقاط فرضية أو تحديد مشتبه به، وشرح سبب تغيّر الحكم أو ثباته عند وصول دليل جديد. يستند إلى شرط الممارسة البريطانية بتسجيل القرار ومبرراته تسجيلاً قابلاً للتدقيق، وإلى معيار ICD 203 في شرح تغيّر الأحكام.
operational_definition: Each key decision has a one-sentence rationale referencing specific evidence; when disconfirming evidence appears, the log shows an update or an explicit reason for no change.
practice_task_pattern: 'Because...' box on key actions; post-case log review with peer/expert character comments.
assessment_method: Log completeness; rationale quality rubric (cites evidence, names alternative); update latency after decisive clue.
observable_evidence: time to update after disconfirming clue
common_errors: persisting with impressions after evidence is discredited
evidence_strength: Professional requirement; no direct evidence on learning effects for teens.
transfer_notes: Supports metacognition and portfolio assessment.

name: Considering absent evidence
summary_ar: السؤال المنهجي: ما الذي كان يجب أن نراه لو كانت هذه الفرضية صحيحة ولم نره؟ يوصي به دليل التقنيات التحليلية المنظمة ضمن تحليل الفرضيات المتنافسة لكشف الخداع والفجوات.
operational_definition: Learner identifies at least one expected-but-missing observation per active hypothesis and uses it to adjust probability.
practice_task_pattern: 'What's missing?' button on hypothesis board; cases with a meaningful absence clue.
assessment_method: Correct identification of designed absence clues; justification quality.
evidence_strength: Practitioner guidance; no controlled evidence found.
transfer_notes: Transfers to scientific controls and critical reading.

name: Statement-evidence consistency checking
summary_ar: مقارنة ما يقوله شاهد أو مشتبه به بالأدلة المستقلة المعروفة، بدل قراءة سلوكه. في تجربة على متدربين في الشرطة، رفع التدرب على استخدام الأدلة استراتيجياً دقة كشف الكذب إلى نحو 85% مقابل 56% بلا تدريب، لأن عدم الاتساق مع الأدلة كان هو المؤشر. يُقدَّم في ATHAR مهارةَ تفكير في الأدلة لا تكتيكَ استجواب.
operational_definition: Learner compares each claim in a statement with independently established facts and timeline, records matches/mismatches, and treats mismatches as questions requiring clarification.
practice_task_pattern: Statement panel side-by-side with evidence board; learner links claims to evidence; mismatches open a calm clarification question (PEACE 'clarify').
assessment_method: Accuracy of match/mismatch tagging; proportion of mismatches pursued with clarification vs accusation.
common_errors: treating any mismatch as proof of lying
revealing all evidence at once and losing diagnostic value
evidence_strength: Single lab experiment with trainees (Hartwig et al. 2006) plus lens-model meta-analysis showing behavioural cues are scarce; field transfer unproven.
transfer_notes: Transfers to fact-checking claims against sources; must never be framed as a technique for pressuring real people.

name: Evidence diagnosticity
summary_ar: مقارنة احتمال ظهور الدليل تحت الفرضية المفضلة وتحت بدائلها؛ الدليل المتوقع بالقدر نفسه في الحالتين لا يميّز. هذا هو جوهر تقييم الأدلة ومضاد التشخيصية الزائفة التي وثقها Nickerson.
operational_definition: Learner estimates P(evidence | hypothesis) and P(evidence | alternative) and labels evidence as diagnostic only when they clearly differ.
practice_task_pattern: On adding a clue to the accusation file, prompt: 'How expected is this clue if the suspect is innocent?'; each mid-level case contains at least one clue consistent with all suspects.
assessment_method: Accuracy of diagnostic/non-diagnostic labels vs expert key; weight given to non-diagnostic clues in final accusation.
observable_evidence: Share of non-diagnostic clues excluded; paired likelihood estimates per clue.
common_errors: counting clues instead of weighing them
evidence_strength: Concept: strong (review evidence). Trainability in this exact game format: untested.
transfer_notes: Prompt should fade over the season; measure unprompted behavior in unannounced cases.

name: Source evaluation and lateral reading
summary_ar: قبل قراءة وثيقة مجهولة، التحقق من الجهة المصدرة ومصالحها عبر مصادر مستقلة. مدققو الحقائق تفوقوا على المؤرخين والطلاب بهذه الاستراتيجية، والطلاب يعتمدون غالباً على إشارات سطحية.
operational_definition: Before reading an unfamiliar document's content, learner checks who produced it and their interests using independent in-world sources.
practice_task_pattern: Official-looking documents from interested parties vs plain-looking honest sources; an in-world 'web' that enables off-page checks.
assessment_method: Steps/time until source checked; signal-detection scoring of credibility judgments; 3-level rubric on written justification.
observable_evidence: Opening external sources before finishing the document; mention of producer/interest in justification.
evidence_strength: Expert-novice description and teen deficit: strong. Intervention effect sizes: not extracted in this session.
transfer_notes: Domain expertise (historians) did not transfer to web evaluation; teach explicitly and probe with real Arabic content after safety review.

name: Measurement reliability and expectancy effects
summary_ar: تحديد مصادر الخطأ في الملاحظة والقياس، خصوصاً أثر توقع الملاحظ، وتفضيل القياس الأعمى أو الآلي. أظهرت إعادة تجربة الإيحاء أن الأثر ظهر فقط حين توقعه المجربون وبالقياس اليدوي.
operational_definition: Learner identifies observer expectancy and instrument error as threats and requests a blind or instrumented measurement when available.
practice_task_pattern: A convinced witness measures manually; an automated tool or blind line-up procedure is available at small cost.
assessment_method: Whether neutral measurement was requested before relying on manual data; whether expectancy was named as error source.
observable_evidence: Request for blind re-measurement; reduced confidence in expectancy-prone measurement.
common_errors: treating a confident measurer as an accurate one
evidence_strength: Single replication study; principle widely accepted in research methods.
transfer_notes: Coordinate with Forensic library (04) on blind procedures; probe in non-forensic contexts (e.g., a teacher grading).

name: Observation vs inference
summary_ar: تصنيف عبارات الشهود والتقارير إلى ما رُئي فعلاً وما استُنتج. مهارة تظهر في أطر التفكير النقدي المفاهيمية، ولم نجد في هذه الجلسة دليلاً تجريبياً مستقلاً على قابلية تعليمها، لذا تُعامل كافتراض تصميمي.
operational_definition: Learner classifies statements into observed vs inferred and asks for the observable basis of each inference.
practice_task_pattern: Witness statement mixing levels ('I saw him flee' = saw a person running); learner rewrites as observation.
assessment_method: Classification accuracy; rubric on rewrite quality.
evidence_strength: Conceptual frameworks only (Delphi, Paul-Elder); no empirical training evidence verified.
transfer_notes: Hypothesis: should transfer to news reading; test with cross-domain probes.

name: Discernment without blanket skepticism
name_ar: التمييز بين الصحيح والمضلل دون شك شامل
summary_ar: قبول الأدلة الموثوقة ورفض المضللة بحيث يرتفع التمييز لا مجرد الرفض. إعادة تحليل ألعاب التحصين بمنحنيات ROC أظهرت أنها رفعت الرفض العام لا التمييز، وتمارين التغذية الراجعة لاحقاً أعادت التمييز.
operational_definition: Learner accepts reliable and rejects misleading evidence such that hits minus false alarms rises, not just rejections.
practice_task_pattern: Matched sets of evidence (similar topic, style, emotional tone), about half genuine, some genuine items looking superficially suspicious.
assessment_method: Signal detection: d-prime or AUC (with confidence ratings); response criterion reported separately.
evidence_strength: Measurement principle: strong. Game effects on discernment: contested; feedback exercises help.
transfer_notes: Discernment, not rejection rate, must be the transfer metric.

name: Hypothesis generation (Peircean abduction)
summary_ar: توليد ثلاثة تفسيرات معقولة على الأقل قبل التقييم، بينها تفسير بريء. يميز الأدب الفلسفي بين توليد الفرضيات (بيرس) وتبريرها (الاستدلال إلى أفضل تفسير). الأساس فلسفي ولم نتحقق من دراسات تعليم هذه المهارة.
operational_definition: Before evaluation, learner lists at least three distinct plausible explanations including a non-criminal one.
practice_task_pattern: Mandatory hypothesis board after the opening scene; mentor asks 'what if no crime happened at all?'.
assessment_method: Count and quality (plausibility, testability) of distinct hypotheses via rubric; whether the true explanation was on the initial list.
common_errors: premature closure on a single suspect
evidence_strength: Philosophical grounding; empirical training evidence not verified.
transfer_notes: Hypothesis: generalizes to everyday explanation; test with non-case probes.

name: Inference to the best explanation with bad-lot check
name_ar: الاستدلال إلى أفضل تفسير مع فحص أفضل السيئين
summary_ar: اختيار التفسير الذي يفسر أكثر الأدلة بأقل افتراضات إضافية، مع التحقق من أنه جيد بما يكفي وليس فقط الأفضل بين المطروح (اعتراض فان فراسن). خيار 'الأدلة غير كافية' يجب أن يكون صحيحاً في بعض القضايا.
operational_definition: Learner selects the explanation covering the most evidence with fewest auxiliary assumptions and checks it is good enough, not merely best of the set.
practice_task_pattern: Contrastive prompts ('why from inside rather than outside?'); 'insufficient evidence / none of these' option always available and correct in some cases.
assessment_method: Correctness of choice; calibrated use of 'insufficient' option (neither over- nor under-used).
observable_evidence: Final decision plus a table of what each explanation explains and fails to explain.
common_errors: choosing best of a bad lot
evidence_strength: Philosophical; contested whether explanatory goodness tracks truth.
transfer_notes: Contrastive questioning is a portable habit; test in science-news probes.

name: Falsification-seeking testing
summary_ar: تنفيذ اختبار رخيص متاح كان سيُسقط الفرضية المفضلة قبل الحكم. لا يُعاقب الاختبار الإيجابي بذاته لأنه غالباً معقول (Klayman & Ha)، لكن تدريب لعبة واحدة خفّض الحل المؤكِّد الأدنى بنسبة 29% في حالة ميدانية غير معلنة.
operational_definition: When a cheap test that could refute the favored hypothesis is available, learner runs it before deciding.
practice_task_pattern: 2-4-6-style structure: the truth is broader than the obvious hypothesis and only a negative test reveals it.
assessment_method: Share of available disconfirming tests executed; choice of the inferior confirming option in a later unannounced case.
evidence_strength: Bias: strong. Game-based debiasing with field transfer: one adult study (not fully randomized).
transfer_notes: Best-documented transferable principle in this library; probe with unannounced cases in new surfaces after 6-8 weeks.

name: Belief revision when evidence collapses
summary_ar: تعديل الثقة بقدر يتناسب مع قوة الدليل الذي سقط أو ظهر، وعدم الاحتفاظ باستنتاج بعد زوال أساسه (ثبات المعتقد). الاستدلال الافتراضي غير رتيب: مقدمات جديدة قد تُسقط استنتاجاً كان مبرراً.
operational_definition: Learner changes confidence in proportion to the strength of evidence removed or added and abandons conclusions whose basis is gone.
practice_task_pattern: Key early clue revealed mid-case as forged while weaker clues remain.
assessment_method: Confidence change vs a benchmark group that never saw the forged clue.
observable_evidence: Confidence time series across the case.
evidence_strength: Phenomenon well documented; training evidence not verified here.
transfer_notes: Probe with retractions in news-like content.

name: Base-rate integration
summary_ar: دمج شيوع الفئة مع دقة الدليل الفردي وبناء فئة مرجعية مبررة. التكرارات الطبيعية والوسائل البصرية ترفع الحلول الصحيحة، وتعليم التمثيل يثبت زمنياً أفضل من تعليم القاعدة، مع تحذير من أن تصنيف الإجابات خاطئة يتطلب فئة مرجعية صحيحة.
operational_definition: Learner combines category prevalence with test accuracy using a defensible reference class.
practice_task_pattern: An 'accurate' lab test for a rare category; numbers as natural frequencies with icon array, then fading to percentages and narrative-only evidence.
assessment_method: Final answer plus correctness of the frequency table (process).
observable_evidence: Cells filled in the frequency table.
evidence_strength: Strong: original studies, meta-analysis, training study; base-rate fallacy partly overstated (Koehler).
transfer_notes: Representation training showed better retention than rule training; transfer to narrative evidence is untested.

name: Qualitative Bayesian updating
summary_ar: تحريك الثقة في الاتجاه الصحيح وبحجم معقول مع كل دليل بحسب قوته التشخيصية دون حساب صريح. يحتاج نموذجاً مرجعياً يضعه خبير لكل قضية.
operational_definition: Learner moves confidence in the right direction and roughly right magnitude after each clue, according to its diagnosticity.
practice_task_pattern: A 'suspicion meter' per suspect adjusted after each clue.
assessment_method: Direction and magnitude of updates vs an expert reference model (approximate).
evidence_strength: Medium: reference model must be expert-validated per case.
transfer_notes: Forecasting training improved calibration on real-world questions in adults (Mellers et al.).

name: Inductive generalization and sample size
summary_ar: ترجيح الاستنتاج المبني على عينة أكبر وأكثر تمثيلاً وتوقع تذبذب أكبر في العينات الصغيرة. من أقدم نتائج برنامج التحيزات، ودراسة كلاسيكية درست تدريب قانون الأعداد الكبيرة على مشكلات يومية (تحتاج مراجعة).
operational_definition: Learner prefers conclusions from larger, representative samples and expects more variability in small samples.
practice_task_pattern: Conflicting testimonies with different sample sizes; interactive variability simulation.
assessment_method: Correct choice between conflicting evidence; variability estimates.
evidence_strength: Bias classic; training study pending full-text verification.
transfer_notes: If Fong et al. 1986 confirmed, statistical rule + varied examples may transfer to everyday problems.

name: Randomness and coincidence
summary_ar: تقدير احتمال المصادفات والتسلسلات دون افتراض تصحيح أو تصميم خفي. مغالطة المقامر الاسترجاعية تكررت في Many Labs بحجم قريب من الأصل.
operational_definition: Learner estimates probabilities of coincidences and streaks without assuming self-correction or hidden design.
practice_task_pattern: A striking streak leads a witness to infer cheating or long history.
assessment_method: Estimates vs normative; whether learner asks for total number of trials.
evidence_strength: Replicated bias; training evidence not verified.
transfer_notes: Probe with 'miracle coincidence' social media stories.

name: Anchor-independent estimation
summary_ar: وضع التقدير من الأدلة قبل الاطلاع على تقديرات الآخرين أو التعديل عن المرساة بما تبرره الأدلة. الإرساء من أقوى الآثار تكراراً، وتدريب لعبة خفّضه مع احتفاظ لأكثر من شهرين لدى البالغين.
operational_definition: Learner records an independent estimate from evidence before seeing others' numbers, or adjusts from an anchor only as far as evidence warrants.
practice_task_pattern: A witness's offhand estimate precedes independent timing evidence (A/B versions with/without anchor).
assessment_method: Between-group deviation toward anchor; individual behavior of logging an estimate first.
evidence_strength: Anchoring effect: very strong. Trainability: one adult game study.
transfer_notes: Probe with price/number estimates outside the game.

name: Causal reasoning and mechanism
name_ar: التمييز بين الارتباط والسببية وطلب الآلية
summary_ar: عدم قبول علاقة سببية من ارتباط وحده، وطلب آلية واستبعاد المتغير الثالث والسببية العكسية. يرى Sloman & Lagnado أن التفكير السببي البشري يتجاوز الاحتمالات إلى الآلية والسرد والمحاكاة الذهنية.
operational_definition: Learner does not infer causation from co-occurrence alone; asks for mechanism and rules out third variables and reverse causation.
practice_task_pattern: A striking correlation in neighborhood records with a discoverable third variable.
assessment_method: Rubric on mentioning alternatives (third variable, reverse, chance) and a mechanism.
evidence_strength: Descriptive science strong; intervention evidence not verified.
transfer_notes: Probe with health/news correlation claims.

name: Counterfactual reasoning
summary_ar: استنتاج ما كان سيتغير في الأدلة لو تغير حدث واحد لاختبار النموذج السببي. مراجعة Byrne متحقق منها ببليوغرافياً ولم يُستخرج محتواها.
operational_definition: Learner predicts which evidence would differ if one event changed, to test the causal model.
practice_task_pattern: 'If the suspect had left at 9 not 10, which clue would be different?'
assessment_method: Correctness of changed/unchanged clue sets vs expert key.
evidence_strength: Review-level support; specifics need full-text check.
transfer_notes: Counterfactual probes are cheap to vary across domains.

name: Narrative and timeline coherence
summary_ar: بناء خط زمني سببي يربط الأدلة وتحديد التعارضات والتمييز بين قصة متماسكة وقصة مدعومة بالأدلة. السرد سمة طبيعية للتفكير السببي لكنه قد يضلل.
operational_definition: Learner builds a causal timeline linking evidence, flags inconsistencies, and distinguishes coherent from evidence-supported stories.
practice_task_pattern: Two coherent stories; only one fits a precise timing clue.
assessment_method: Ordering accuracy; number of inconsistencies found.
evidence_strength: Medium.
transfer_notes: Probe with conflicting accounts of a school event.

name: Argument analysis and mapping
summary_ar: تحديد الادعاء والأسباب والأدلة والاعتراضات والردود وتمثيلها في خريطة. ندوة 12 أسبوعاً في تصوير الحجج حسّنت الاستدلال المنطقي والمقالات، لكن بتصميم شبه تجريبي وعينة منتقاة.
operational_definition: Learner identifies claim, reasons, evidence, objections and rebuttals and represents them in a map.
practice_task_pattern: Final accusation built as a map; dissecting an NPC's argument.
assessment_method: Map completeness and correctness of support/oppose links via rubric.
evidence_strength: Medium: one quasi-experiment (d 0.71/0.87) plus expert essay; meta-analysis not verified.
transfer_notes: Requires sustained practice with feedback; probe with essay-based tasks.

name: Counterargument and otherside thinking
name_ar: توليد الحجة المضادة والتفكير في الطرف الآخر
summary_ar: توليد أقوى حجة ضد الاستنتاج أو الموقف المسبق وتقييم الأدلة الموافقة والمخالفة بالصرامة نفسها. الانحياز الجانبي يكاد لا يرتبط بالذكاء، والحوار بين الأقران نقل مهارة الحجة لدى مراهقين إلى موضوعات جديدة.
operational_definition: Learner produces the strongest case against own conclusion or prior position and scrutinizes congenial and uncongenial evidence equally.
practice_task_pattern: Devil's-advocate step before accusation; matched pro/con evidence on a fictional pre-stated issue.
assessment_method: Rubric on counterargument quality; asymmetry in verification requests between congenial and uncongenial evidence.
observable_evidence: Verification requests and ratings by evidence side.
evidence_strength: Bias measurement strong; dialogic training evidence in adolescents (one multi-year program).
transfer_notes: Kuhn & Crowell: transfer to essays on new topics after sustained dialogue.

name: Manipulation technique recognition
summary_ar: تحديد التقنية المستخدمة في رسالة جديدة (لغة عاطفية، ثنائية زائفة، كبش فداء، هجوم شخصي، انتحال). التعليم على مستوى التقنية ينتقل إلى محتوى جديد بحسب دراسات التحصين، مع جدل حول قياس التمييز.
operational_definition: Learner names the manipulation technique in a new message and discriminates manipulative from non-manipulative matched messages.
practice_task_pattern: In-world posts and statements; fictional 'play the manipulator' mode followed by balanced discernment drill.
assessment_method: Technique-naming accuracy plus signal-detection discernment.
evidence_strength: Medium: large RCTs on recognition; discernment effects contested; decay without boosters.
transfer_notes: Technique (not topic) is the transferable unit; needs spaced boosters.

name: Confidence calibration
summary_ar: تطابق الثقة المعلنة مع الدقة الفعلية عبر الأحكام. التدريب الاحتمالي والعمل الجماعي حسّنا المعايرة في بطولة تنبؤ حقيقية لدى البالغين.
operational_definition: Stated confidence matches actual accuracy across judgments.
practice_task_pattern: 0-100 confidence before each accusation and credibility judgment.
assessment_method: Calibration curve, Brier score, over/underconfidence index.
evidence_strength: Measurement standard; adult training evidence; teen game evidence missing.
transfer_notes: Calibration is domain-sensitive; track per skill and across surfaces.

name: Intellectual humility (argument-strength sensitivity)
name_ar: التواضع الفكري وتغيير الرأي لأسباب جيدة
summary_ar: تعديل الموقف حين تكون الحجة المضادة قوية وعدم تعديله حين تكون ضعيفة. أصحاب التواضع الفكري المرتفع كانوا أكثر حساسية لقوة الحجج المقنعة في دراسة Leary وزملائه.
operational_definition: Learner updates more for strong than for weak counterarguments (sensitivity, not mere willingness to change).
practice_task_pattern: Strong and weak arguments against learner's stated position in a crossed design.
assessment_method: Difference in opinion change between strong and weak arguments.
evidence_strength: Medium: self-report scale correlates; behavioral measure is a design proposal.
transfer_notes: Reward 'changing your mind for good reasons' explicitly.

name: Cognitive flexibility in investigation
summary_ar: الانتقال إلى فرضية أو منظور آخر حين يظهر دليل نافٍ دون مثابرة على الخيط القديم. المرونة المعرفية إحدى الوظائف التنفيذية الأساسية، لكن نقل تدريب الوظائف التنفيذية العام مشكوك فيه.
operational_definition: Learner switches hypothesis or perspective after disconfirming evidence without perseverating.
practice_task_pattern: An invested lead (time, points) is refuted by strong evidence.
assessment_method: Actions/time to switch; abandonment rate of refuted lead vs non-invested controls.
evidence_strength: Concept strong; general EF training transfer doubtful (Sala & Gobet).
transfer_notes: Do not claim general flexibility gains; measure the specific behavior.

name: Reflective override and metastrategic awareness
summary_ar: التوقف عند جواب سريع جذاب للتحقق، ووصف الاستراتيجية المستخدمة ومتى تنجح، بما في ذلك متى يكون الاختصار الحدسي مناسباً للبيئة. تجمع المهارة بين فكرة CRT ونموذج Kuhn للمعرفة الثانية والعقلانية البيئية.
operational_definition: Learner pauses on an attractive fast answer to check it, and can describe the strategy used and when it works (including when a heuristic fits the environment).
practice_task_pattern: Original intuitive-lure items (never CRT copies); metastrategic question in debrief.
assessment_method: Rate of correct overrides; rubric on strategy description.
evidence_strength: Medium; CRT confounded with numeracy.
transfer_notes: Metastrategic awareness theorized as enabling transfer (Kuhn); untested in games.

name: Calibrated likelihood language
summary_ar: قدرة المتعلم على التعبير عن درجة يقينه بلفظ احتمالي له معنى رقمي ثابت، وعلى ترجمة الألفاظ إلى أرقام والعكس. تُبنى على أدلة عبر اللغات بأن الألفاظ تُفهم بتباين كبير ما لم تُقرن بأرقام. وهي شرط لقياس المعايرة في ATHAR.
operational_definition: Given evidence, the learner selects a likelihood term whose numeric band contains their stated probability, and converts between term and number consistently across contexts.
practice_task_pattern: Before a reveal, the learner tags each suspect hypothesis with a term-plus-band; after the reveal, feedback shows hit/miss and Brier contribution; occasional 'translation' mini-tasks (term to number and back).
assessment_method: Brier score and calibration curve on numeric midpoints; consistency of term-number mapping over time.
observable_evidence: share of judgments where chosen term matches entered number
common_errors: dialect synonym used with a different meaning
evidence_strength: Cross-linguistic adult evidence strong; one 2026 study with English secondary students; no Arabic data.
transfer_notes: Directly relevant to news, health and science communication outside the game.
